    Wrapper Function for download_kof_data

    download_kof_data_wrapper.Rd

    This function wraps the download_kof_data to handle the decision wether to call it. If the file isn't saved at the given path or there is an explicit instruction to download the data the wrapper skips the download. The wrapper also returns a message on what it does.

    download_kof_data_wrapper(
  file,
  kof_data_key = kof_data_key,
  do_api_call = FALSE,
  kof_api_key = NULL
)

    Arguments

    file

    String. Path to the file, including it's name: "C:/Users/user1/Downloads/filename.csv

    kof_data_key

    String. Reference to what dataset should be downloaded. Found on KOF Webpage.

    do_api_call

    Bool. Set to TRUE if you want to force an datadownload even if data has already been downloaded

    kof_api_key

    String. KOF API Key if needed.

    Value

    None. The function doesn't return anything: It prints messages and downloads directly

    See also

    [download_kof_data()]

    Examples

    if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
download_kof_data_wrapper("data/kof_raw.csv", "kof_dataset_123", do_api_call = TRUE, kof_api_key = my_kof_api_key)
} # }
